title: Windows native installer staged execution
classification: The installer correctly accepts Node 22 and the explicit database-skip path, but this run could not complete because pip could not reach PyPI.

environment.python: 3.12.16, provisioned inside the isolated staging directory
environment.node: 22.23.4, provisioned inside the isolated staging directory

method.database: PostgreSQL check and database creation skipped; no database connection attempted.
method.launch: The installer did not reach its final start prompt; the application was not started.

observed: Python 3.12 and Node.js 22.23.4 prerequisite checks passed.
The synthetic game and library directories were accepted.
The installer stopped during pip's pip-upgrade step after PyPI connections failed with Windows socket error 10013.
The SPA dependency install/build, native runtime validator and staged .env generation were not reached.
The checkout root .env was not read or modified; the staged source had no .env before execution.
result: incomplete: environment network restriction prevented end-to-end installer acceptance
independent_prior_evidence: All five native SPA entry points and the native runtime validator had previously passed under Node 22.23.4 on Windows; this run does not repeat or invalidate that result.
limits: This does not qualify a normal online Windows installer run or other target operating systems.
No installer assets were built during this run.
